name: Toolbar settings (default)
description: The shared default settings interface for every toolbar (chrome-settings@1): how the Settings dialog you reach by right-clicking one is laid out. The app toolbar and every plugin toolbar (lib-toolbars). The Widgets tab lists the widgets attached to this toolbar (toolbar-widgets@1) with their banner widget style, shape, order and Detach, and attaches more. Every app gets its own copy (chrome-toolbar-<app>) that follows this one until edited; this default is what the dialog uses unless an app picks its copy.
